investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC refinement probe: single unauthenticated GET of the official_programme_url, no browser/auth/retries; music-relevance assessed only from the retrieved content.

probe_history.reason: The single GET returned a WordPress page using The Events Calendar (Tribe Events) plugin. Its own inline JSON state reports "There are no upcoming events" for the /events/ list view, and every retained past/recent event card (e.g. "The Comedy Hump") is tagged with the site’s own event-category class cat_comedy and described as a stand-up night. This conclusively answers the music-relevance question without escalation.

venue_reference: Backyard Comedy Club — Cambridge Heath Road 231, E2 0EL, London

identity.notes: Retrieved page title ("Events - Backyard Comedy Club") and domain (backyardcomedyclub.co.uk) match the reported candidate name.

site_classification.platform: WordPress running The Events Calendar (Tribe Events) plugin — evidenced by tribe-events-* CSS classes and the page’s own "This calendar is powered by The Events Calendar" HTML comment.

title.notes: Individual event titles (e.g. "The Comedy Hump") are present in retained cards, but the live /events/ list view itself reported no upcoming events at fetch time; not promoted to a claimed current-programme title.

start_date.notes: Retained cards carry explicit datetime attributes (e.g. datetime="2024-12-04") for past events; the live list view reported no upcoming events at fetch time.

event_url.notes: Retained cards carry stable-looking permalink URLs (e.g. /event/the-comedy-hump-19/) but stability was not independently verified.

blockers.description: Every retained event card is tagged with the site’s own cat_comedy taxonomy and describes stand-up comedy programming ("The Comedy Hump" — "the biggest stand-up stars and the best new acts"); this is comedy, not live bands/concerts/jazz/electronic/DJ-club-nights/classical, and fails BeatMapped’s venue-level music gate regardless of technical acquisition feasibility.

reasons: Real, retained Level-1 evidence (the site’s own event-category taxonomy and event descriptions) shows the venue’s programme is stand-up comedy, confirming the pre-triage expectation that Backyard Comedy Club is not a live-music venue.
No live band/concert/jazz/electronic/DJ/classical programming of any kind is present anywhere in the retrieved page.

evidence.description: Literal, unedited excerpt (one full Tribe-Events event-card block, including its cat_comedy taxonomy class and description text) from the single unauthenticated GET of https://backyardcomedyclub.co.uk/events/.
evidence.method: curl; descriptive User-Agent; unauthenticated single GET; redirects followed; 20s timeout; no retry
